{{Quote|That was the ''Ecliptic''. The images were relayed to Coruscant by the Famulus, one of the ships of House Vandron that led our mission into the Senex sector. All twenty judicials aboard the Ecliptic are presumed dead.|Finis Valorum|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''''Ecliptic''''' was a [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]]. It was part of a mission dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] to apprehend the leaders of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. ''Ecliptic'' and its sister ship, the [[Prominence (Consular-class)|''Prominence'']], came under attack by Nebula Front forces; while the ''Prominence'' crashed onto Asmeru, ''Ecliptic'' was destroyed when it hit a mine over the planet while trying to escape. All twenty of its crew were [[Death/Legends|killed]] .<ref name="CoD" />
